name: Tabouleh
author: joel-maxuel on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 2 cups Very Hot Water (or as directed)

steps: Soak the cracked wheat in the hot water until the water is absorbed, about 30 minutes.
Drain any excess water, if necessary, and squeeze dry.
Combine the salad ingredients (all but the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper dressing ingredients) in a medium bowl.
Mix the dressing ingredients together and stir into the salad mix
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

culture.text: Tabbouleh, also transcribed tabouleh, tabbouli, tabouli, or taboulah, is a Levantine salad of finely chopped parsley, soaked bulgur, tomatoes, mint, and onion, seasoned with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and sweet pepper. Some variations add lettuce, or use semolina instead of bulgur.
